title: test
content:
In its four-year medium range forecast up to 2026-2027, the Financial
Secretary anticipates that there will be an annual surplus of between HK$30 billion
and HK$65 billion, under the assumption of a 3% real economic growth per annum
and similar rate of growth for tax revenue.

title: test2
content:
The forecast however has included the expected proceeds from annual issuance of green bonds at HK$35.1 billion between2023-2024 and 2025-2026, 
 without which the budget would only be just balanced in2023-2024 and 2024-2025.
